Method of Attack: Shows fake login screens on top of legitimate banking apps
Whitelists its process to remain active during phone sleep mode
Uses TeamViewer to grant attackers full access to infected devices
Intercepts phone calls to banks and redirects them to scammers
Calls victims from a special number displayed as the bank's number to carry out scams
Attack Vector: Links shared on social media sites
Indicators of Compromise: Found inside 22 Android apps distributed via third-party app stores and social media links
